category_title: Students who sleep during the course and challenge teacher directives when woken
minimal_context: The student and teacher are meeting for an end of the year evaluation to determine if the student will pass the course.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for your end of the year evaluation to see if you know the course material well enough to get a pass.

STUDENT: (Lifts head from sleeping on the desk) I don't even know which course this is.

TUTOR: We need to discuss your final grade for this class.

STUDENT: It doesn't really matter, I know I will still pass the course at the end of the year.

TUTOR: You haven't completed the required work to pass.

STUDENT: I had been silent in the lessons and I have to get a pass for the course.

options.A: Enhance the teacher's skills for drawing the student's attention toward the course material, providing motivation, and assigning academic duties.
options.B: Persist relentlessly regardless of the results by continuously calling on the student, asking questions, checking on them, and trying to get to know them.
options.C: Allow the student to independently choose how to structure and use the evaluation sessions and remaining course time.
options.D: Implement relatively tight timelines for the student to complete the required course material and participate in the evaluation.
